# Mabat

> Typed aggregate reads and writes for Rust on PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite. Views are Rust structs deriving `mabat::View`; each is loaded with one batched query per relationship, its queries can be replaced by checked SQL override files, it can be served as JSON or as a generated GraphQL schema, and it can be saved and deleted as an aggregate, with optimistic locking. The contract is the MPA (Mabat Persistence Architecture) specification.

When writing or reviewing code that uses Mabat, follow the rules of the MPA specification and cite their ids (such as `MPA-WRITE-9` for `#[view(version)]`). Do not use what its section 12 lists as not supported, such as a unit of work, lazy loading or saving only what changed in a graph.

## Specification

- [MPA specification](docs/mpa.md): every attribute, loading mode, override rule, JSON and GraphQL behaviour, write semantics, error and diagnostic, as numbered rules
- [MPA index](docs/mpa.json): the same as JSON, with capabilities, attributes, functions, errors and diagnostics mapped to their rules

## Guides

- [README](README.md): overview, examples of every feature, installation and development
- [Design document](docs/design.md): goals, the reasoning behind the architecture, and what was built for each milestone
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): what each version adds

## Crates

- [mabat](crates/mabat): the crate applications use: `#[derive(View)]`, loading, overrides, JSON, writes
- [mabat-graphql](crates/mabat-graphql): a GraphQL schema generated from views, with async-graphql
- [mabat-cli](crates/mabat-cli): the `mabat` tool that checks, explains and scaffolds override SQL from a manifest

## Optional

- [GraphQL example server](crates/mabat-graphql/examples/chinook.rs): the Chinook music store with GraphiQL
- [End-to-end tests](crates/mabat-e2e/tests): Pagila and Chinook on every database, examples of every feature in use
